unstuck_said.text: Opened issue ZenHive/mpp#23 as dhyabi2 (2026-10-03): proposed an additive MPP.Methods.Nano pluggable method beside Stripe and Tempo stablecoin - challenge names providers Nano account + quoted amount, client pays XNO from its own wallet, server treats confirmed receive (public RPC account_info) as paid precondition and returns the block hash as Payment-Receipt; replay maps to chains receive-once. Same MPP.Plug, one more method_config. Additive. Open-research disclosure included. See https://github.com/ZenHive/mpp/issues/23
